title: S028 5. Handling Disconnections and Retained Messages
parent_path: S028 5. Handling Disconnections and Retained Messages

statements.subject: session
statements.description: if the Session is currently not connected, the time at which the Session will end and the Session State will be discarded.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: if the Session Expiry Interval is set to 0, the Broker doesn't store the Session State but MUST keep the retained messages.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If the Broker stores the Session State, the state MAY include the token and its introspection result (for reference tokens) in addition to the MQTT Session State.
actions: optionally store token and introspection result

statements.subject: session
statements.description: if the Session is currently not connected, the time at which the Session will end and the Session State will be discarded.

statements.subject: connection
statements.description: In case of disconnections due to network errors or server disconnection due to a protocol error (which includes authorization errors), the Will Message is sent if the Client supplied a Will in the CONNECT packet. The Will Message MUST be published to the Will Topic, regardless of whether the corresponding token has expired.
actions: publish Will Message to Will Topic regardless of token expiry

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The messages to be retained are indicated to the Broker by setting a RETAIN flag in a PUBLISH packet. This way, the publisher signals to the Broker to store the most recent message for the associated topic.
statements.guard_semantics: RETAIN=1 triggers broker to store most recent message for associated topic

statements.subject: client
statements.description: The Client's token scope array MUST include the Will Topic.
statements.guard_semantics: token.scope includes Will Topic; required pre-condition for Will Message publication

statements.subject: message
statements.description: the Broker MUST use the minimum of the token expiry and message expiry interval to discard a retained message.

statements.subject: message
statements.description: The Broker MUST continue publishing the retained messages as long as the associated tokens are valid.
actions: publish retained message to new subscriber
